notes: Official publisher documentation and CAD downloads reviewed for Waveshare ESP32 and Raspberry Pi MCU boards. Exact configurable-product prices and unconfirmed physical board revisions remain unknown. RP2040/RP2350 CAD URLs were recovered from printed Waveshare wiki copies and verified directly on the official files host; see fixture evidence notes. Public access does not establish redistribution rights.

products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero (4MB Flash / 2MB PSRAM, without header)
products.description: Compact Waveshare development board with an ESP32-S3FH4R2 processor, wireless connectivity, USB Type-C, castellated edges, and an onboard RGB LED. This entry selects the 4MB Flash / 2MB PSRAM option without pre-soldered headers.
products.compatibility_notes: SKU 25081 is the 4MB Flash / 2MB PSRAM board without headers. Exclude the pre-soldered-header SKU 25517 and the N8R8 variants 33879/33549. The official CAD filename includes v2, but the documentation does not establish its exact physical board revision; confirm fit and antenna clearance before mechanical design. The configurable shop page does not establish a reliable exact per-SKU price.

products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3
products.description: Waveshare ESP32-S3 display development board with a 4.3-inch 800x480 capacitive touch LCD, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity, CAN, RS485, I2C, a TF card slot, and USB Type-C. This entry selects the version with touch function.

specifications.Interfaces: CAN, RS485, I2C, TF card, USB Type-C

products.compatibility_notes: Select only touch SKU 25948; the shop also lists no-touch SKU 30493. This model is for ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4.3, not the distinct 4.3B/4.3C products. The official ZIP contains esp32-s3-touch-lcd-4_3.stp without an explicit hardware revision. The configurable shop page does not establish a reliable exact per-SKU price.

products.name: Waveshare RP2040-Zero
products.description: Compact Waveshare development board based on Raspberry Pi RP2040, with USB Type-C, castellated PCB edges, an RGB LED, 264KB SRAM, and 2MB board Flash.
products.compatibility_notes: The official CAD ZIP contains RP2040_Zero.stp. A board revision and pre-soldered-header compatibility are not specified, so this is a mechanical reference without an inferred current storefront SKU or sales offer. RP2040 is the chip designer/family; Waveshare manufactures this board.

products.name: Waveshare RP2350-Zero
products.description: Compact Waveshare development board based on Raspberry Pi RP2350A, with USB Type-C, castellated PCB edges, an RGB LED, 520KB SRAM, and 4MB board Flash. The RP2350A offers selectable dual-core Arm Cortex-M33 or Hazard3 RISC-V processor architectures.

specifications.Processor: Dual-core Arm Cortex-M33 or Hazard3 RISC-V

products.compatibility_notes: The official CAD ZIP contains RP2350-Zero.step. A board revision and pre-soldered-header compatibility are not specified, so this is a mechanical reference without an inferred current storefront SKU or sales offer. This is distinct from RP2350-Zero-CM, RP2350-One, and RP2350-Plus.
